accept.skills:blow-by-blow: turns Claude Code session transcripts into a PDF; it reads Claude's own session files
accept.skills:whatsapp-local-data: lives in the house repo and is linked into ~/.claude/skills by hand; link it into ~/.agents/skills when Codex needs it
accept.hooks:Notification .claude/sounds/notify: sounds stay Claude-only (MA8): Codex has no Notification event
accept.hooks:Stop .claude/sounds/stop-if-idle.s: sounds stay Claude-only (MA8): the job's-done chime pairs with the Notification one, which Codex cannot fire
accept.hooks:PermissionRequest .claude/hooks/au: Codex runs approval_policy never, so no permission dialog ever opens to deny
accept.hooks:SessionStart .claude/hooks/clear-h: clears the pane tag that set-label.sh sets; the status line and its label are Claude-only
accept.hooks:UserPromptSubmit .claude/session-l: the status-line label reminder; Codex has no status line
accept.hooks:SessionStart .claude/hooks/herdr-a: herdr's own Claude adapter (HERDR_INTEGRATION_ID=claude); Codex runs herdr's Codex adapter
accept.hooks:SessionStart .codex/herdr-agent-st: herdr's own Codex adapter (HERDR_INTEGRATION_ID=codex), installed by herdr; Claude runs herdr's Claude adapter
accept.settings:env:CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WI: a Claude Code setting; Codex has its own compaction
accept.settings:env:NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_BROWSER_C: written by the Codex app for its node_repl browser tool
accept.settings:statusLine: Claude Code status line; Codex has none
accept.settings:enabledPlugins: Claude plugins; the shared capabilities are mapped in agent-common/tooling.json
accept.settings:effortLevel: Claude model effort; Codex sets model_reasoning_effort
accept.settings:skipDangerousModePermissionProm: Claude bypass-mode prompt; Codex runs approval_policy never
accept.settings:preferredNotifChannel: Claude Code notifications; sounds are Claude-only
accept.settings:model_reasoning_effort: Codex model effort; Claude sets effortLevel
accept.settings:notify: the Codex app's computer-use turn hook
accept.settings:plugins: Codex plugins; the shared capabilities are mapped in agent-common/tooling.json
accept.settings:tui: each tool's own terminal UI (Claude Code and Codex both have a tui key, different meanings)
accept.mcp:chrome-devtools: Claude gets it as the chrome-devtools-mcp plugin (agent-common/tooling.json)
accept.mcp:context7: Claude gets it as the context7 plugin (agent-common/tooling.json)
accept.mcp:playwright: Claude gets it as the playwright plugin (agent-common/tooling.json)
accept.mcp:computer-use: the Codex app's own computer-use server
accept.mcp:node_repl: the Codex app's own browser REPL server
accept.mcp:openaiDeveloperDocs: OpenAI docs for Codex; Claude has the claude-api skill
